name: payflow-frontend
description: Portal do lojista do PayFlow: Shell + microfrontends com Module Federation

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shell,payments,account -c green,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @payflow/shell" "npm run dev -w @payflow/mfe-payments" "npm run dev -w @payflow/mfe-account"
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n shell,payments,account -c green,blue,magenta "npm run preview -w @payflow/shell" "npm run preview -w @payflow/mfe-payments" "npm run preview -w @payflow/mfe-account"
scripts.test: npm run test:architecture && npm run test:unit
